messages.subject: How to include a function for barplot
parts:
Hi everyone,

i'm having a hard time to try to reproduce some of my findings.

i want to use a simple barchart with conf interv. using the following code

bar<- ggplot(ants, aes(Tunel, ratioegg, fill=Type,))
bar + stat_summary(fun.y=mean, geom="bar", position="dodge") + 
  stat_summary(fun.data=mean_cl_normal, geom="errorbar", position=position_dodge(width=0.90), size=0.4,width=0.2)

my problem is doing the ratio egg, I don't know how to make a function that would show the egg number per type of ant divided for the frequency of that type of ant. but showing all the types in the plot... so to compare the ratio of egg between the types... but with conf interv.
this will give me the raw number but have no idea how to make it a function to load it in the plot: sum(ants$egg[which(ants$type=="queen")]>3)/length(which(ants$type=="queen"))


This is the example
structure(list(Ant.ID = structure(1:13, .Label = c("a", "b",
